analogs.covers: Solo life: a silent, cold-loving ambusher with a small home range, sunning itself on rock faces
Seasons and den: the changing coat, and the search for a family to join

solo.headline: A lone snow leopard of the cool hills: silent, low to the ground, sunning on rock faces in its small favourite range.
solo.playsLike: Solo you are quieter than any grouped Yutyrannus, knowing that without a hunting party you can be hunted yourself. You keep to a small area you like, looking for other Yutyrannus to group with or a comfortable place to nap and preen. You ambush smaller and weaker prey, staying low and moving in complete silence, and hunt only up to Medium tier. You sleep on rock faces and cliffsides, soaking in the sun. Groups will posture at you and may challenge you out. The dry-season heat still wears you down.

why.text: “A solitary Yutyrannus typically has a small biome or defined area they enjoy to travel through”, as a snow leopard patrols its own stretch of mountain.
Loners focus on “ambushing smaller and weaker prey, staying close to the ground and moving completely silently”.
They are “often seen in comfortable sleeping places on rock faces and cliffsides, soaking in the sun”, like a snow leopard resting on a ledge.
It prefers the cool rainy season and struggles in the dry-season heat, a cold-climate specialist like both animals.

notLike: Snow leopards are solitary for life; a lone Yutyrannus is always also looking for a group.
Snow leopards kill prey several times their own weight; a solo Yutyrannus hunts only up to Medium tier.
solo.summary: Solo bist du ein Schneeleopard: still, geduldig und immer auf der Hut, weil du ohne Jagdgruppe selbst zur Beute werden kannst. Du streifst durch ein kleines Lieblingsgebiet und suchst nebenbei nach anderen Yutyrannus und nach einem gemütlichen Platz zum Dösen und Putzen. Du jagst nur bis Medium, lauerst flach am Boden und bewegst dich völlig lautlos. Geschlafen wird an Felswänden und Klippen in der Sonne. Gruppen drohen dir und können dich aus dem POI fordern. Die Hitze der Trockenzeit macht dir allein genauso zu schaffen.
